Messages.Author: Gwen Morse
Messages.Body:
Blood Bond - Action (2):
Is a (D) action. (errata) [RTR] :D01:
Its effect will cease when the targeted vampire leaves play. [RTR]

Does leave play mean:

(1) Leave being active (ie: torpor)...or...whatever state it is a
vampire leaves when they go to torpor. (I get 'ready' and 'active'
confused still)

(2) Is burned, and placed in ash heap.

(3) Is somehow 'removed from game' (ie: burned in such a way as to no
longer be accessible to ressurection).

Gwen
